summary: Federal Home Loan Bank of Atlanta filed a Form 8-K on July 29, 2026, announcing the appointment of Alp E. Can, age 50, as Chief Operating Officer, effective August 10, 2026. Can previously served as Chief Risk Officer since 2017 and Executive Vice President since 2020. His appointment and compensation are subject to review and non-objection by the Federal Housing Finance Agency. The filing is a routine officer appointment, not a forced departure. No material terms, compensation specifics, or advisor details are disclosed. The event is a standard executive organizational change, with no special-situation deal mechanics. Watch for regulatory approval and any subsequent executive transitions.
